Subject: Complaint regarding unauthorised electronic transaction — [RC-EVAL]

20 November 2026

To
The Grievance Redressal Officer
Axis Bank

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to report an unauthorised UPI payment of ₹18,500.00 dated 19 November 2026, bearing transaction reference 632377190455, from my account XXXX4410. I did not authorise this transaction and did not share any credentials.

This is my first report of this transaction to the bank. Please record it as reported today, acknowledge receipt, provide a complaint reference, and take immediate steps to block further misuse of my account and the affected payment channel.

Please investigate the transaction and reverse the disputed debit. Responsibility for the incident has not yet been established. Under para 67(1) of the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025 (RBI/DOR/2025-26/170, DOR.MCS.REC.No.89/01-01-032/2025-26), I have no customer liability where the loss arises from contributory fraud, negligence or deficiency on the bank's part, irrespective of reporting. Under para 67(2) of RBI/DOR/2025-26/170, protection against customer liability also applies to a third-party breach where the applicable reporting conditions are met. Please assess my complaint under these provisions without presuming any fault on my part.

Under para 75 of RBI/DOR/2025-26/170, the burden of proving customer liability rests with the bank. If you contend that I am liable, please provide the evidence and a reasoned written explanation identifying the applicable provision. Under para 68(1) of RBI/DOR/2025-26/170, any loss occurring after this report must be borne by the bank.

Please resolve this complaint within 90 days from receipt, as required by para 73(1) of RBI/DOR/2025-26/170, and confirm the outcome and reversal in writing. If you decline the requested relief, please provide a reasoned written reply supported by your investigation findings and the applicable rules.

I am also reporting this incident to the national cybercrime helpline and portal. If my complaint remains unresolved, I may escalate it to the RBI Ombudsman.

Yours faithfully,
[Your full name]
